title: I-30 photos Dallas

pageHeader.title: Roadside Views between Garland and East Dallas
pageHeader.lastUpdated: Aug 15, 2026 (add new photos, remove obsolete photos)

text:
The LBJ East project began in 2021, and in 2022 the original interchange at I-635 LBJ Freeway was demolished. The original interchange opened in 1970 was the first modern-design four-level interchange in North Texas, and was the first of six interchanges which used the distinctive "double T" central pylon. The I-30 archive photos include views of the original interchange. The new interchange was fully complete in 2026.

Projects to widen the freeway and add frontage roads on new bridges at the Lake Ray Hubbard crossing started in July 2021 (Bass Pro Dr. to Dalrock Rd.) and March 2023 (Dalrock Rd. to SH 205). The section from Dalrock to SH 205 is scheduled for completion in January 2027.

TxDOT has long-term plans to rebuild and expand the freeway from I-45 to I-635, with construction expected in the late 2030s or 2040s.
